outcome: Frequency of Triple P program use by educator practitioners
cohort: The study included 404 Triple P educator practitioners from English-speaking countries who completed self-report questionnaires and responded to open-ended questions.
finding: Organisational support, perceived usefulness, and practitioner self-regulation were the most important positive predictors for frequency of program use, while novel barriers included Covid-19/work from home, online delivery, parent factors, and specific organisational factors.
